raw:
Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted clues leading to a wrong class set: chose Druid for the “bear” instead of a Hunter’s bear pet, and Demon Hunter for “Metamorphosis” instead of Warlock, which broke the 2-plate/2-cloth constraint and ignored Frost Death Knight as the “ice” DPS. Also misread the Kilt of the Forgotten One implication. This produced an inconsistent and incorrect final list (Demon Hunter, Druid, Mage, Paladin, Priest) instead of the correct Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock.
